prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1106; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, surveillance footage, repair estimates, and any internal notes or communications. Please treat this letter as formal notice of a claim and confirm in writing that the evidence will be retained.

We look forward to your prompt response.
